meta.label: Detached house purchase price by comune (2025H2)
meta.source: Agenzia delle Entrate — Osservatorio del Mercato Immobiliare (OMI)
meta.methodNote: Purchase price of "Ville e Villini" (OMI's detached-house category) in normal condition, €/m², averaged across a comune's own OMI micro-zones. Every other price layer here describes Abitazioni civili — apartments — so this is a different product, not a variant. Comuni where OMI prices no detached housing are absent, never filled in with the apartment figure. OMI semester 2025H2.
